messages:
maria_cs: heads up — we have a growing queue of onboarding flows stuck at SSO step for Dedicated customers in eu-west-1. noticed spike ~09:15 UTC, some accounts moving to renewal window next month.
raj_eng: on it, looking at autoscale logs for dedicated pools. any sample tenant ids?
dena_support: i pulled a few, tenant ids: t-873, t-912, t-119. customers report 401 on callback and long retries.
maria_cs: thanks. main ask — we need a short customer-facing status note + a prioritized outreach for 6 accounts flagged as renewal-risk. draft below, please gut-check: 

"Dear customer — we’re aware some Dedicated onboarding flows are failing at the SSO step. Engineering is investigating; we’ve identified an autoscaling mismatch that can delay provisioning. We’ll update within 2 hours and offer a credit + live office hours to affected accounts. — Redwood CS"

sam_sales: wording is fine, add expected ETA to resolution if we can give one. renewal teams will need exact list.
raj_eng: root cause appears to be a race between the dedicated pool cold-start and the SSO token exchange; when the pool scales up there’s a short window where callbacks return 401. quick mitigation: pin callback retries to 5s backoff + short circuit to a fallback auth proxy. deploying now to canary.
maria_cs: good — can we get a rollback plan in case canary causes regressions? we need timelines for customer comms.
raj_eng: rollback = revert proxy flag (feature-flagged). canary in 15m, monitor 30m, then rollout to region if green.
dena_support: we should notify affected tenants that we’ve started a mitigation deploy and to expect intermittent retries for 30–60 minutes.
maria_cs: draft update to send to affected list (short): 

"Update: we’ve deployed a targeted mitigation to reduce SSO callback 401s. You may see intermittent retries over the next hour while we verify. No action needed from your side; we’ll follow up when complete and offer a one-time account credit. — Maria, CS"

sam_sales: add line that we’ll schedule a dedicated office hours session for high-touch accounts (include calendar link after confirmed).
raj_eng: canary shows 80% reduction in failures for t-873 / t-912 after 20m. still seeing edge cases for t-119 (older metadata). pulling logs now.
dena_support: capturing customer reports into the incident ticket: INC-5829. i’ll add links and timezone availability for office hours.
maria_cs: please compile the renewal-risk list and earliest renewal date for each by EOD. we’ll prioritize exec outreach if renewal < 30 days.
ops_bot: deploy-canary finished at 1822224600, health checks OK, alerting muted for 30m to avoid noise.
maria_cs: action items: 1) raj — complete rollback plan + finish log triage (ETA 1h). 2) dena — send short status update to affected tenants (now) and add to INC-5829. 3) sam — prepare renewal-impact list and draft exec outreach for <30d renewals. 4) maria — consolidate credits offer and office hours scheduling.
raj_eng: noted, will post final RCA + remediation timeline in this thread once complete.
dena_support: sending the status note now. copying the CS template for traceability.
maria_cs: thanks team. keep this thread tight — only essential updates. i’ll pull a customer-facing digest for CSMs in 2 hours. :pray:
